lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Montreal’s mayor is walking back a comment she made in the aftermath of her administration’s latest budget that was widely perceived as being tone deaf in the context of higher taxes, CityNews Montreal reports.

Nova Scotia’s new Liberal leader is calling on her former colleagues in the Progressive Conservative government to put a planned AI data centre project in Cape Breton on hold, The Canadian Press reports.
Macy’s 100th annual Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed from Thursday to Saturday as powerful winds are expected to bear down on New York during the annual event, organizers said Wednesday.
Are this year’s Black Friday deals the best discounts on offer this year?, The Canadian Press reports.
Vance says Jensen Huang won’t need a pardon as scrutiny of Nvidia scandal builds in Washington, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
